stem.text: A sphere falls from rest through the air. The graph shows the variation with time of the sphere's velocity.

stem.alt: Graph of velocity against time with the origin marked 0 and a point labelled P on a curve.

stem.text: Which diagram shows the forces acting on the sphere when it is at the velocity corresponding to point P on the graph?

A.alt: Circle with an arrow labelled air resistance pointing upward and an arrow labelled weight pointing downward.

B.alt: Circle with a single arrow labelled weight pointing downward.

C.alt: Circle with an arrow labelled air resistance pointing upward and an arrow labelled weight pointing downward.

D.alt: Circle with an arrow labelled air resistance pointing upward and an arrow labelled weight pointing downward.
